features.name: Versioned design specification validation
features.description: Validate schema 1.0 documents, supported node fields, IDs and resource limits.
features.nextAction: Extend schema and regression cases for additional Figma node features.

features.name: Native Figma rendering and asset insertion
features.description: Create editable basic design nodes; import sanitized SVG as vector geometry and validated PNG/JPEG/GIF bytes as native image fills.
knownIssues: Asset operations are not live-verified; images and SVGs are not part of design-spec schema generation, replacement/crop operations are not implemented.
features.nextAction: Run a live Figma import for sanitized SVG and PNG/JPEG/GIF; verify node dimensions and image fill.

features.name: Selection inspection and edit patches
features.description: Bounded selection inspection and targeted text, fill, rename, bounds and frame Auto Layout edits with up to 20 session undo checkpoints.
knownIssues: Live Figma preservation and Undo are not reverified.
features.nextAction: Reimport and verify targeted edits, Auto Layout, undo and unchanged sibling layers.

features.name: Selected design export
features.description: Export one selected supported layer tree to a schema-validated design specification.
knownIssues: Only one selection; unsupported nodes/paints fail explicitly; no round-trip test.
features.nextAction: Verify selected export/import round-trip and add adapter tests.

features.name: Provider-neutral AI handoff
features.description: Prepare generation/edit prompts for user-controlled copy/paste, include local color/typography/spacing tokens, and validate returned JSON.
features.nextAction: Retain manual import fallback as other integrations are added.

features.name: Optional local Ollama adapter
features.description: Discover installed local Ollama models and request bounded structured generation over loopback.
knownIssues: Integration suite uses a fake local server; no real model has been verified.
features.nextAction: Record actual Ollama/model results only when runtime is available.

features.name: VSN startup loader and plugin panel
features.description: Show bundled VSN logo loader and load responsive plugin workflows.
features.nextAction: Complete broader UI accessibility and visual QA.

features.name: Loopback companion HTTP service
features.description: Serve optional local model endpoints with origin checks, payload bounds and loopback binding.
features.nextAction: Keep runtime and future bridge endpoints separated by contract.

features.name: Custom MCP server and asset tools
features.description: Expose validated Figma selection, design operations and manual asset import/validation to compatible MCP clients through the official SDK.
knownIssues: Client-specific registration and live Figma invocation are not tested; large raster batch transfer is automated-tested but not live-verified.
features.nextAction: Test asset tools through a live Figma pairing and actual MCP client file-transfer capability.

features.name: Authenticated local Figma bridge
features.description: Correlate, queue and return MCP-originated operations for paired plugin sessions over loopback.
knownIssues: Local machine pairing is required; no remote bridge is supported.
features.nextAction: Keep bridge bound to loopback and confirm browser Figma pairing on a desktop host.

features.name: Live agent activity and jobs
features.description: Show bridge connection, operation events and actual outcomes inside the plugin.
knownIssues: UI event display and secure pairing have not yet been exercised in a live Figma session.
features.nextAction: Re-import the build, pair with local token, then verify activity and returned results in Figma.

features.name: Figma compatibility adapter and matrix
features.description: Separate universal semantic properties from Figma-specific API mappings and capability evidence.
knownIssues: No dedicated compatibility adapter or automated changelog audit exists.
features.nextAction: Extract semantic mappings and test against installed official typings.

features.name: AI-readable repository memory and audits
features.description: Keep source-backed registry, status, handoff and docs validation synchronized.
features.nextAction: Update the source registry and README task table whenever shipped scope changes.

features.name: UTF-8 bounded size accounting
features.description: Measure JSON text by UTF-8 bytes so non-ASCII input cannot bypass size limits.
features.nextAction: Keep byte-limit edge cases in schema regression tests.

features.name: Validated local raster and SVG import and reuse
features.description: Validate bounded SVG and PNG/JPEG/GIF payloads; support 5 MiB raster import through atomic, SHA-256 verified 64 KiB MCP chunks; insert natively, verify node readback, and persist originals in the paired local bridge library.
knownIssues: Live Figma insertion, paired bridge persistence and large MCP transfer remain unverified; generated AI file retrieval varies by client and is not inferred; replacement/crop operations are not implemented.
features.nextAction: Re-import the current build, pair Claude from plugin Settings, and verify SVG/raster save, preview/reuse, reload persistence, and a raster larger than 192 KiB through the paired MCP bridge.
